headline: SpaceX catches Starship upper stage for the first time
summary: SpaceX successfully caught the Starship upper stage for the first time using its Mechazilla tower, after previously aborting a planned catch. Outlets agree the ship catch was a first, though The Register notes the attempt to also catch the Super Heavy booster failed this time.

claims.statement: SpaceX successfully caught the Starship upper stage for the first time.

sources.quote: SpaceX successfully catches Starship after launch for the first time
Watch SpaceX successfully execute the first ‘chopstick’ catch of Starship

claims.statement: SpaceX has caught Super Heavy boosters before, but catching the Starship vehicle itself was new.

sources.quote: While the company has pulled off this trick a few times with Super Heavy boosters, it was a first for the Ship.
The company has performed 'chopstick' catches of its boosters before, but this is the first time the maneuver has successfully been executed on the Starship vehicle itself.

claims.statement: The catch followed a previously aborted attempt on the same booster/flight.

sources.quote: After aborting a planned catch of Starship Flight 15's booster, SpaceX successfully captured Starship with its "Mechazilla" launch and catch tower for the first time.

discrepancies.explanation: The Register notes the booster catch failed on this attempt, a detail the other outlets' given text does not mention.

quotes.quote: Double capture eludes company for now as booster fumbled
it was a first for the Ship
